requirements.evidence: 3 full bases at 0,0 0,1 1,0 plus half-w at -1,0 forming compact L-shape (~310x310mm deck f14) with 4 covers providing continuous top surface. Refs: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;half-w + covers.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: Mount spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) where the three full bases meet, verified by addSpike offer s14.
Spike accessory platform-lrg set on mount spike via setSpikeAccessory, provides small platform display at corner.

finish.summary: Built compact L-shaped desk (3 full + half base) with covers forming desk top. Notch drawer provides drawer requirement. Mount spike at three-base junction carries large platform.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
